verification.title: Forecast accuracy check
verification.sentence: Panchayat forecasts from model {{model}} for every issue date from {{start}} to {{end}} (lead days 1 to 5), compared with {{truth}} by three checks: {{checks}}.
verification.sentenceNoModel: Panchayat forecasts for every issue date from {{start}} to {{end}} (lead days 1 to 5), compared with {{truth}} by these checks: {{checks}}.
verification.mockNotice: Synthetic demo data, not real weather: this shows how the checks work, not real-world skill.
verification.testOpened: Test period first opened {{when}}. Reused after tuning: {{reused}}.
verification.consistency: Panchayat values average back to the block forecast: largest gap {{gap}}.
verification.tableCaption: Scores of the model and three baselines, {{check}}
verification.howToRead: Bold marks the best value in each row. Skill is 1 minus the model score divided by the baseline score: above 0 the model is better. The words better, worse and no clear difference come from the 95% interval.

metrics.MAE_wet_days_obs_ge_1mm: Mean absolute error on wet days (1 mm or more observed)

verification.eventsCaption: Yes/no scores for rain events, model and block forecasts
verification.eventGroup: {{event}}: happened in {{rate}} of {{n}} forecasts. Brier skill vs monthly climatology {{bss}}.
verification.reliabilityHelp: Each dot is a group of forecasts with similar chances. On the diagonal, rain came as often as forecast. Bigger dots hold more forecasts.
verification.noPoints: No reliability points for this event
verification.coverageHelp: The likely range (p10 to p90) should contain what happened 8 times in 10. Above the line the range is wider than it needs to be; below it the range is too narrow.
verification.coverageAxis: Share of outcomes inside the range

strata.wet_days: Wet days (1 mm or more observed)

verification.regionsHelp: Blocks: the model was refitted without that block and forecast it. Stations: forecasts at the station's Panchayat against the station.
verification.regionsCaption: Mean absolute error by held-out block and station, {{variable}}
verification.lossesTitle: Where the model does not help
verification.lossesEmpty: The verification job reported no score where the model is worse than or level with a baseline.

impact.title: Decision replay
impact.summary: {{n}} decisions: one per Panchayat for the next day, on each issue date from {{start}} to {{end}}. The event happened {{events}} times.
impact.summaryNoPeriod: {{n}} decisions, one per Panchayat for the next day. The event happened {{events}} times.

meanings.spray: Wasted wait: spraying was held and less than {{threshold}} {{unit}} of rain came. Washed off: spraying went ahead and {{threshold}} {{unit}} or more came.
meanings.heat_alert: False alarm (wasted wait in the data): an alert was given and the maximum stayed below {{threshold}} {{unit}}. Missed heat (washed off): no alert and the maximum reached {{threshold}} {{unit}}.
meanings.irrigation_wait: Waited, no rain (wasted wait): irrigation was held and less than {{threshold}} {{unit}} of rain came. Irrigated, then rain (washed off): irrigation went ahead and {{threshold}} {{unit}} or more came.

impact.tableHelp: Bold marks the most correct and the fewest of each mistake. The two mistakes do not cost the same; no costs are applied until an expert supplies them.
